lessons.title: Functions: Your Script's Toolkit 🧰
lessons.description: Learn what functions are, how to define and call them, and why they make your scripts modular.

lessons.title: Arguments & Return Values 📥
lessons.description: Pass data into functions via positional parameters and get results with return codes or output.

lessons.title: Scope: Local vs Global Variables 🌐
lessons.description: Control where variables live using `local` – avoid accidental overwrites and side effects.

lessons.title: Modular Scripting: Sourcing Files 📦
lessons.description: Organise reusable functions into separate files and include them with `source` or `.`.

lessons.title: Advanced Functions & Best Practices 🏗️
lessons.description: Explore recursion, error handling, naming conventions, and writing robust function libraries.
